description: This file defines an abstract class 'RilSocket' representing sockets in the Radio Interface Layer daemon (rild). It includes member variables for socket name and ID, a constructor, a method to retrieve the socket ID, and a virtual destructor. The class is intended to handle socket listening and command callbacks within the rild component.

classes.name: RilSocket
classes.description: An abstract class representing a socket in the rild component, managing socket name and ID, and providing interface methods for socket operations.
